scope: Publish exact source/results bytes with bounded, reconstructible byte chunks.

summary.scope: All744-stage U barrier history figure with exact source data, accepted editable source, complete exports, actual font/rendering failures and RGB/grayscale QA

source_qa.scope: Plot every audited barrier-history stage and retain exact data, scope and editable artwork.

delivery_verification.scope: Exact744-row CSV/source equality, editable SVG, accepted RGB/grayscale layout and final export/source closure verification
delivery_verification.PDF_verification_method: Decode each FontFile2 stream by its actual PDF object length; verify Length1, TrueType signature and cmap/glyf/head/name tables.

limitations: Every one of744 stages and all original raw bounds remain. Editable65-text SVG, embedded-TrueType PDF,1000dpi PNG, exact CSV, source/claim/caption/body/alt-text handoff and inspected RGB/grayscale previews are preserved. Real missing-font and source-QA failures retain actual code1 and closed sources; accepted source and exports retain actual code0. These deterministic plots add no continuum convergence, statistical uncertainty, full application or warmed cost acceptance. Files of at least50MB are preserved as exact ordered32MiB byte ranges, individually gzip-compressed, with original/part/stored SHA256 and offsets. Join decompressed ranges in index order to restore the original file exactly; no records are reduced or excluded. Runtime staging uses hard links for unchanged small originals.
